findings.finding: The 30/30 ordered-pair balance is exact only for the 30 within-block transitions. Five sequential cross-block transitions also exist on the same host. The design must explicitly exclude those transitions from the Williams balance claim, retain first-position balance, record previous cross-block condition, and prohibit causal attribution to a specific carryover mechanism.

PASS_TOTAL_SPLIT_DECOMPOSITION_REMAINS_UNDERIDENTIFIED and VALID_NEGATIVE_DECOMPOSITION_UNSTABLE_AFTER_BALANCING are not mutually exclusive under the frozen rules. Final outcome classes must be made mutually exclusive before execution.

required_action: Supersede pre-execution design with v0.3 clarifying cross-block transition scope and a single mutually-exclusive decomposition-underidentified outcome, then review again.
